title: RAG-LLM ICD-10 coding pipeline and audit protocol (context-limited component-wise audit)
description:
The audit protocol from the paper Why a Retrieval-Augmented LLM Loses to TF-IDF at ICD-10 Coding: A Component-Wise Cautionary Study. It contains the note-blind floor, the loss decomposition (oracle-over-shortlist bound and random-pruning null), note-level paired bootstrap and approximate-randomization testing, the cross-patient evidence-provenance measurement, a verbatim-grounding metric the model cannot self-report, a provenance guard for machine-generated tables, and a script that re-checks every number reported in the manuscript against its stored artifact.

The release contains the full pipeline (retrieval, LLM scoring, evidence constraint, contrastive verification, baselines, optimization) as well as the audit code, so that the paper's negative result can be checked against the implementation that produced it.

No clinical data are included. MIMIC-IV is available to credentialed researchers through PhysioNet under its data use agreement and is not redistributed here; the stored artifacts are aggregates and carry no identifiers.
